items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: when I was fourteen years old, teaching him to play the saxophone.

ctx.x: when I was fourteen years old, teaching him to play the saxophone. We were the same age. We were in the same class in school. And I started him out. He ended up really being something. And he has two kids who they tell me are really spectacular musicians. So it looks like we started something!
His name was Carl Lee Otis. And as most of the band-leaders did, when they became bandleaders, he had to get a title -- so he's Duke Otis! [LAUGHS]
